requestsDirectory.description: Directory of request JSON files. Relative paths resolve from this configuration file. Subdirectories are included.

executable.description: PowerShell 7 executable name or absolute path.

loadProfile.description: Load PowerShell profiles, making profile functions such as LocalLaya available.

id.description: Unique preset id. Different configurations of one model must have different ids.

command.description: PowerShell command with a standalone, unquoted {input} placeholder. The runner quotes the file path.

warmupCommand.description: Optional warm-up command. Can use an unquoted {input} placeholder; receives the first selected request. Runs separately from comparisons.

workingDirectory.description: Working directory, resolved relative to the config file.

timeoutMs.description: Per-entry timeout, overriding the global value. Applies to comparisons and warm-ups.

env.description: Environment variables to pass to this invocation's PowerShell process.

reasoningEffort.description: Must be advertised by the selected model. Omit for its default. List models and efforts with npm run models:llm.

systemPrompt.description: The complete replacement system prompt. The request JSON is sent unchanged as the user message, with a matching structured-output schema.

cliPath.description: Optional Copilot executable or JS entry point. Defaults to the installed native CLI on PATH, then the SDK's bundled runtime. Relative paths resolve from the config file.
